meta.title: 3 Days in Da Nang & Hoi An Vietnam 2026 - A Travel Guide for First-Time Visitors
meta.description:
#vietnam #danang #hoian 
A lot of you asked about my color grading 🙏
I’ve released my cinematic LUT pack + TwoClick PowerGrade here: https://lais.store/
These are the exact tools I use for my travel documentaries.
____________________________
After living and travelling across Vietnam for over a year, I’m sharing my personal 3-day itinerary for Da Nang and Hoi An. In this video you’ll see Da Nang’s beaches, Marble Mountains, Dragon Bridge, Son Tra Night Market and best cafés, plus a full day trip to the UNESCO-listed ancient town of Hoi An with its lantern-lit streets, local markets and hidden gems.
Perfect for first-time visitors looking for things to do in Da Nang & Hoi An, where to eat, the best day trips and tips for planning your Vietnam itinerary.
____________________________
Hotel I can recommend:
Canvas Danang Beach Hotel: https://www.trip.com/t/CLpj0KqZrV2
____________________________

Chapters: 
00:00 Intro
00:22 Day 1: Coffee, Marble Mountains, Pizza at the Beach, promenade, best Banh Mi in Da Nang
04:39 Day 2: full day trip to Hoi An (ancient town, lanterns, local food)
12:19 Day 3: Ba Na Hills Golden Bridge, relaxing at Caribou food truck, Dragon Bridge at night & Son Tra Night Market

comments.text: This is probably one of the best first-time guides to Da Nang & Hoi An I've seen. The mix of beaches, food, and local culture makes the trip worth it already. I actually went for Vietnam dental tourism and ended up spending a few extra days exploring the city. The dental care was surprisingly high quality and much more affordable than back home, so combining treatment with a holiday was a no-brainer. I used dentaltrip to compare clinics around Da Nang before booking, and it made planning the whole trip much easier.

comments.author: @froilanromualdo2755
comments.text:
June 5 to 7, 2026: We enjoyed visiting Da Nang and Hoi An, in Vietnam. Good food. Clean and nice (Rest hotel, Homestay LISA 2 in Hoi An, and Chi Thanh Villa in Hoi An). 

We enjoyed visiting Coconut Boat area. And riding cable car and nice view in SunWorld Ba Na Hills, and saw the Golden Bridge.

Nice and clean and beautiful architecture in French Village in Ba Na Hills. Lots of international tourists.

I love the authentic food (Vietnamese food with meat and vegetables). :)

If we will have the opportunity and resources to visit Da Nang, and Hoi An in Vietnam, we will visit the place again.

Thank you Da Nang, Vietnam for the beautiful and peaceful place and hospitality of the Vietnamese people!

Thanks for the nice vlog!

comments.author: @Xaremathraas
comments.text:
Lmao...
Day 1:
1) Arrive in Da Nang and go to the most expensive/Westernized cafe
2) Eat an expensive non-Viet meal
3) Marble Moutains - good choice
4) Eat pizza (3rd western food visit already) and enjoy beach at night
5) Eat banh mi (finally some Viet food)

Day 2:
- again expensive coffee shop
- LEAVE DA NANG for Hoi An


Day 3: 
- LEAVE DA NANG for Ba Na Hills
- My Khe Beach
- See Dragon Beach
- Son Tra Night Market  

So in other words, outside of the Beach, Marble Mountains, and cheap food, nothing to do in actual Da Nang :)
